text:
Priya K: Deploybot flagged a p95 regression for the embeddings route after the kv migration. Seeing +30% latency on canary :eyes:

deploy-bot: [alert] Canary latency threshold breached (p95=420ms > 320ms). Suggested action: partial rollback to previous model variant or disable kv-migration flag.

Jonah L: Agree rollback. Can we avoid a full DB/migration rollback? Proposal: flip `kv_migration="v2"` -> `"v1"` via feature flag, drain kv cache, then roll model if needed.

Maya S: Timeline? I can run the flag flip but need a 10m observation window. Recommend a 50/50 traffic slice rollback first.

Priya K: OK 50/50 for 10m, then 100% if metrics stabilize. Who's on runbook for drain + purge?

ops-runner: I'll execute drain + cache purge. Commands I will run: `rctl drain --pool=canary && rctl purge-kv --namespace=embeddings` (will post logs).

Jonah L: After purge, hold for 10m. If error-rate or p95 returns to baseline -> unpin migration; else we'll revert model to v2.9.0 and pin versions.

Maya S: Notifying product + release-notes channel and legal per the rollback comms checklist. Draft blurb: "Temporary rollback performed to address latency regression; no data loss expected. We'll follow up with full postmortem."

deploy-bot: Rollback action scheduled by Priya K at 2026-03-21T14:12Z. Mode: staged-feature-flag-flip. Strategy: 50% -> 100%. Status: in_progress.

Priya K: Executing flag flip now. @ops-runner please confirm when drain done.

ops-runner: drain done, purge kicked off (ETA ~90s) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-runner: purge complete. Posting first sample logs: `purge: 1200 keys removed; latency-improvement-checkpoint`. Monitoring 10m slice.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics update: p95=310ms, error-rate stable. Suggest promoting rollback to 100%.

Maya S: Promote to 100% now. I'll update customer note with exact timeframe and contact point.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Rollback finished. Status: success :white_check_mark:. Release notes updated to include rollback entry.

Priya K: Filing postmortem and adding a canary regression test for kv-migration to the CI suite. Thanks team for the quick exec.
